content.text:
**Finding: missing (medium)** — no transition/exit rights anywhere in the Agreement.

- § 3.5 "Effect of Termination" covers only accrued payment obligations; nothing on wind-down, transition help, or data.
- Full-text searches for "transition", "export", "delete", "Customer Data" return no hits; "return" appears only in the IP indemnity (§ 8.1) and the signature block. §§ 11.6 and 14.18 merely allocate responsibility for Content and contact information — they give us no return or deletion right.
- Fix: inserted a new § 3.5.1 requiring IBM to (a) provide up to 6 months' transition assistance at then-current rates, (b) return all Content/Customer data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and (c) then delete and certify deletion. § 14.2 already lists § 3.5 as surviving, so no further edit was needed.
- Fallback offered in the comment: 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.
